default_runlevel.description: Default runlevel used when an init script doesn't specify LSB runlevel information. Common values: 2 (multi-user), 3 (multi-user with networking), 5 (multi-user with GUI).

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging during dependency resolution to help debug service ordering issues.

force_symlinks.description: When true, preserve existing symlinks during upgrades instead of regenerating them — useful for avoiding disruption in production.

ignore_services.description: Space-separated list of service names to skip during dependency resolution (e.g., services managed by systemd or containers).

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth during dependency resolution. Prevents stack overflow or infinite loops in circular dependencies.
